translations.web: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
translations.bsb: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
translations.kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
translations.asv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
